core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nilofar corresponds to the Persian form نِيلُوفَر and is glossed in this record as “Water lily, lotus.” The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nilofar corresponds to the Persian form نِيلُوفَر (Persian نیلوفر (nīlūfar)). Its core sense is water lily, lotus. Nilofar is Persian نیلوفر (nīlūfar) 'water lily, lotus'. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave نيلفر (a non-standard form) and labelled the origin Arabic; the word is Persian. The source gloss 'Lotus Flower' is consistent. Same name as nelofar.

persian.name: نیلوفر
persian.long_meaning: Nilofar (نیلوفر) نامی برگرفته از زبان فارسی است و معنای اصلی آن نیلوفر، نیلوفر آبی است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
